title: B-OPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Self-Generated Problem Briefs
abstract: arXiv:2611.19273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has recently attracted interest because it provides dense teacher guidance without a separate, often larger teacher model. However, OPSD conditions its teacher on ground-truth solutions, which limits its use when such solutions are unavailable. We propose On-Policy Self-Distillation with Self-Generated Problem Briefs (B-OPSD). Using a prompt template, the initial model or a saved student checkpoint generates a problem brief from the question alone. The prompt asks for relevant principles, applicability conditions, and likely pitfalls, but not a final answer or a complete solution. A frozen teacher uses the brief as privileged context to guide the current student's on-policy rollouts through token-level distribution matching. B-OPSD uses no ground-truth solutions during training. Results on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025 show that both B-OPSD variants achieve higher average accuracy than OPSD at eac

translated_title: B-OPSD：基于自生成问题简报的在线策略自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）近来受到关注，因为它无需一个单独的、通常更大的教师模型即可提供密集的教师指导。然而，OPSD以真实标准答案解作为教师模型的输入条件，这限制了它在这些解不可得时的使用。我们提出了基于自生成问题简报的在线策略自蒸馏（B-OPSD）。通过使用提示模板，初始模型或保存的学生检查点仅根据问题本身生成一个问题简报。该提示要求给出相关原理、适用条件和可能的陷阱，但不要求给出最终答案或完整解答。一个冻结的教师模型将该简报作为特权上下文，通过token级别的分布匹配来指导当前学生模型的在线策略采样。B-OPSD在训练过程中不使用任何真实标准答案解。在AIME 2024、AIME 2025和HMMT 2025上的结果显示，两种B-OPSD变体在每个基准上的平均准确率均高于OPSD。
tldr: B-OPSD让模型自行从问题生成不含答案的简报（包含原理、适用条件和常见陷阱）来替代标准答案解作为教师模型的指导上下文，实现了无需真实解的在线策略自蒸馏，并在数学竞赛基准上取得了优于OPSD的准确率。
en_tdlr: B-OPSD replaces ground-truth solutions with self-generated problem briefs—containing relevant principles, applicability conditions, and likely pitfalls but no answers—as teacher context, enabling ground-truth-free on-policy self-distillation that outperforms OPSD on AIME and HMMT math benchmarks.
